title: fix: pass Albumentations 2.x arguments for GaussNoise and CoarseDropout

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+"""Helpers to build Albumentations transforms across 1.x and 2.x APIs.
+
+Albumentations 2.x renamed several arguments (``GaussNoise(var_limit=...)`` ->
+``std_range`` and ``CoarseDropout(max_holes=...)`` -> ``num_holes_range``) and
+silently ignores the old names, so they must be passed by the right name.
+"""
+
+import inspect
+import math
+
+import albumentations as A
+
+
+def make_gauss_noise(
+    var_limit: tuple[float, float] = (10.0, 50.0), p: float = 0.5
+) -> "A.GaussNoise":
+    """Create ``A.GaussNoise`` with a variance range given in 8-bit pixel units."""
+    if "std_range" in inspect.signature(A.GaussNoise.__init__).parameters:
+        # 2.x: std_range is a fraction of the max pixel value.
+        std_range = (math.sqrt(var_limit[0]) / 255.0, math.sqrt(var_limit[1]) / 255.0)
+        return A.GaussNoise(std_range=std_range, p=p)
+    return A.GaussNoise(var_limit=var_limit, p=p)
+
+
+def make_coarse_dropout(
+    max_holes: int = 8, max_height: int = 32, max_width: int = 32, p: float = 0.5
+) -> "A.CoarseDropout":
+    """Create ``A.CoarseDropout`` matching the 1.x fixed-size behaviour."""
+    if "num_holes_range" in inspect.signature(A.CoarseDropout.__init__).parameters:
+        return A.CoarseDropout(
+            num_holes_range=(max_holes, max_holes),
+            hole_height_range=(max_height, max_height),
+            hole_width_range=(max_width, max_width),
+            p=p,
+        )
+    return A.CoarseDropout(
+        max_holes=max_holes, max_height=max_height, max_width=max_width, p=p
+    )

@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+"""Albumentations 2.x must receive the arguments it actually understands."""
+
+import importlib.util
+import warnings
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+    "_albu_compat", Path(__file__).parent.parent / "geoai" / "_albu_compat.py"
+)
+compat = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
+_spec.loader.exec_module(compat)
+
+
+def test_gauss_noise_args_not_ignored():
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error")
+        t = compat.make_gauss_noise(var_limit=(10.0, 50.0), p=1.0)
+    img = np.full((64, 64, 3), 128, dtype=np.uint8)
+    out = t(image=img)["image"]
+    std = float(out.astype(np.float32).std())
+    # variance 10..50 -> std ~3.2..7.1 (not the 2.x default of ~0.2*255)
+    assert 1.0 < std < 12.0
+
+
+def test_coarse_dropout_args_not_ignored():
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error")
+        t = compat.make_coarse_dropout(max_holes=8, max_height=32, max_width=32, p=1.0)
+    if hasattr(t, "num_holes_range"):
+        assert t.num_holes_range == (8, 8)
+        assert t.hole_height_range == (32, 32)
+        assert t.hole_width_range == (32, 32)
+    else:
+        assert (t.min_holes, t.max_holes) == (8, 8)
+        assert (t.min_height, t.max_height) == (32, 32)
+        assert (t.min_width, t.max_width) == (32, 32)
+    img = np.ones((256, 256, 3), dtype=np.uint8) * 255
+    out = t(image=img)["image"]
+    # 1.x behaviour: 8 holes of 32x32 at random positions. Each hole lies fully
+    # inside the image, so at least one hole is dropped; overlaps keep the total
+    # at or below 12.5%. Bounds are exact, so the test does not depend on the RNG.
+    frac = (out == 0).mean()
+    assert 32 * 32 / (256 * 256) <= frac <= 8 * 32 * 32 / (256 * 256) + 1e-6
